text.p: Oil production by AO Tatneft, excluding joint venture output, edged down in 1996 to 23.70 million tonnes from 24.14 million in 1995, the company's public relations company Glashatai said on Monday.

Joint venture output in 1996 was 1.1 million tonnes, it said. Glashatai did not have comparative data for 1995, but according to the magazine Rynok Aktsii, joint ventures produced 0.83 million tonnes in 1995.
"The basic task of the company in 1996 of stabilising the level of oil output was fulfilled," a statement from Tatneft Chief Executive Rinat Galeyev said.

Tatneft is a regional oil company. The government of Russia's autonomous republic of Tatarstan owns 32 percent of the company and employees and management hold 41.34 percent. In December it placed 10 percent of its capital in the form of American Depositary Shares.
